recommendation: Keep the audit commit on the combined branch and follow up in the RDF/ShEx generator used by the build, especially hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core ShExGenerator/TurtleParser integration, so Uri and Canonical shapes allow optional fhir:l consistently with current RDF prose and examples.
issue_request: FHIR-25620 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that canonical.shex account for the optional RDF link element shown by canonical Turtle values, especially QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-25620 source commit was found in this checkout. Current generated Turtle examples include the canonical fhir:l sibling, and current source/rdf.html documents fhir:l for uri and its subtypes, including canonical, but current CI Canonical/Uri ShEx still omit that property.
additional_context: FHIR-53178 later renamed the R5 fhir:link property to fhir:l for R6, requires it for URI-like primitive values, and points generated Turtle/ShEx implementation work to org.hl7.fhir.core and related external PRs. The HL7/fhir checkout only packages generated ShEx artifacts and does not contain the Java ShEx generator.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No HL7/fhir source hunk was made because editing narrative text or generated-looking artifacts would not fix the generated ShEx mismatch.
